title: Unlocking Investment Wisdom - With Howard Marks, Co-Founder of Oaktree Capital Management
summary: His investment memos written over the years are world class: engaging, lucid and approachable. In this 1 hour conversation, Howard Marks shares some of his most important investing lessons. It’s a conversation everyone interested in investing should hear.
